methodologyNotes: Covers standalone wrist- and watch-style scuba/freedive dive computers sold at a published US price. Excludes fitness smartwatches without a true decompression/dive mode and bottom-timer depth gauges that do not track no-decompression limits. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. algorithm is the published decompression model as printed by the maker (e.g. Buhlmann ZHL-16C, RGBM, DSAT/PZ+). maxDepthRatingM is the manufacturer depth rating in meters. displayType is the panel technology as an enum: 'amoled', 'color-lcd', or 'segment-lcd'. displaySizeIn is the display diagonal in inches. airIntegration is true if the unit supports wireless (hoseless) tank-pressure transmitters, else false. gasMixes is the maximum number of programmable nitrox/trimix gases. diveModes is the count of distinct operating modes the maker lists (e.g. air, nitrox, gauge, freedive, CCR). digitalCompass is true if a tilt-compensated 3-axis compass is built in. batteryType is an enum: 'rechargeable' (sealed Li-ion), 'user-replaceable' (owner-swappable cell), or 'field-replaceable'. batteryLifeDiveHrs is rated dive-mode runtime in hours per full charge or battery. bluetooth is true if the unit syncs to a companion app over Bluetooth. weightGrams is body weight in grams.

Retailer price was shown in EUR (region-dependent), so the USD figure comes solely from the manufacturer page.
